content:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ⛑️ - High error rate on prod inference routes. Alerting on-call.
Alex W: I’m on pager. Seeing 502s from model-serving behind the API gateway. Logs show deploy failures in CI.
Maya S: Can you paste the failing job link?
Alex W: deploy-bot: failed job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/1234567890 - error fetching package from npm.pkg.github.com — 503 from package registry
Jen K: GitHub Actions is spitting up 503s for our package fetches? That would block hotfix builds.
Luis R: Confirming same: ephemeral runner fails to pull @redwood/serving-runtime:0.9.2 from GH package registry.
Rahul P: Is this global GitHub outage? Check status.github.com
Sam T: Status shows degraded performance for Packages and Actions in multiple regions: https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/abcd1234
Alex W: Customer impact: new deploys can't build, so hotfixes for the incident are blocked. Traffic on older instances still serving but we can’t push rollback images if we need them.
Maya S: What’s the mitigation plan? Can we re-point our builds to S3 hosted artifacts or use Docker Hub mirror?
Jen K: We have a zipped wheel and container snapshot in S3 for last stable build: s3://ci-artifacts/redwood/serving-runtime/0.9.1.tar.gz
Luis R: We can create a temporary job to pull artifacts from S3 and build a container directly on our self-hosted runners.
Alex W: Can someone craft a quick manual deploy command? If we can publish image to our ECR, we can push a hotfix without GH package registry.
Rahul P: Steps: 1) Download artifact from S3 2) Build image locally on runner 3) Tag and push to ECR 4) Update k8s image tag and rollout.
Sam T: I’ll spawn a self-hosted runner and run the job. Starting now.
deploy-bot: pipeline trigger: manual/hotfix-s3 → runner-42
Maya S: Alex, while Sam ties up that path, open an incident update for customer ops: we need to note that deploys are blocked by GitHub Packages outage and that we plan a temporary ECR flow.
Alex W: Writing update: "Root cause: third-party outage (GitHub Packages & Actions). Impact: prevents CI from fetching private packages -> blocks builds/deploys. Mitigation: manual build from S3 and push to ECR for emergency hotfix; rolling back possible only if image present in ECR. ETA for mitigation: ~20-40m." Sending to #customer-notifications for approval.
Jen K: FYI, our access tokens to GH Packages expire hourly for the CI job; even if GH recovers, we may need to re-run jobs. Keep that in mind.
Luis R: Sam: any logs from the runner attempt?
Sam T: Runner job fails with: "GET https://npm.pkg.github.com/: Received 503 from package registry". I aborted and switched to S3 job. Build succeeded locally, pushing to ECR now.
Sam T: Pushed image redwood/serving-runtime:hotfix-1938001234 -> ECR
Alex W: K8s rollout: kubectl set image deployment/model-serving model-serving=123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/serving-runtime:hotfix-1938001234
deploy-bot: rollout started for deployment/model-serving
Maya S: Monitoring for errors during rollout.
Rahul P: If this goes green we should document the ECR fallback in runbook and add a checklist for third-party outage path.
Jen K: Good call. Also add a note to try re-running blocked GH Actions after registry recovers; some stale auth tokens need refresh.
Alex W: Rollout progressing: 3/5 pods updated -> healthchecks passing on new pods.
Sam T: New pods are healthy. Error rate dropping from 12% to 1.2% over last 5m.
incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE - Mitigation in progress: emergency ECR deploy succeeded, traffic stabilizing. Continue monitoring.
Luis R: I’ll open a post-incident ticket to capture timeline and customer impact numbers (requests failed, duration, customers affected).
Maya S: On-call handoff in 15m? I’ll take from Alex after we confirm stability.
Alex W: Handing off to Maya S. I’ll remain available for escalation. Great job everyone :thumbsup:
Maya S: Taking over. Next steps: 1) keep watch for regression 2) confirm GH Packages returns 3) orchestrate CI back to normal once we can fetch packages 4) write the incident blameless postmortem.
Rahul P: Also loop in platform security to approve ECR temporary image usage for any compliance notes.
Alex W: Logged customer impact note into incident ticket and notified key accounts via #customer-notifications. Marking as mitigated for now.
Sam T: filing a PR to add S3->ECR fallback script to ci-scripts repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci-scripts/pull/789
Jen K: Thanks all. Keep updates to thread only for continuity. If GH fully recovers, mention timestamp and results of re-run.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. End of thread will be recorded when last message_ts is updated.
